functions.name: bump_listing_leads_count
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bump_listing_leads_count()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.listings SET leads_count = leads_count + 1 WHERE id = NEW.listing_id;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, avatar_url)
  VALUES (NEW.id, COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', split_part(NEW.email,'@',1)), NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url')
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

  -- default role agent; user can change later
  INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role)
  VALUES (NEW.id, COALESCE((NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'role')::public.app_role, 'agent'))
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  RETURN NEW;
END; $function$

functions.name: has_role
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role app_role)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role = _role) $function$

functions.name: increment_catalog_downloads
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_catalog_downloads(_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  INSERT INTO public.company_profiles_extra (company_id, downloads_count)
  VALUES (_company_id, 1)
  ON CONFLICT (company_id) DO UPDATE
    SET downloads_count = company_profiles_extra.downloads_count + 1;
$function$

functions.name: increment_partner_click
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_partner_click(_offer_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.partner_offers
  SET click_count = click_count + 1,
      updated_at  = now()
  WHERE id = _offer_id AND is_active = true;
END;
$function$

functions.name: increment_referral_click
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_referral_click(_code text)
 RETURNS TABLE(listing_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  UPDATE public.referrals
  SET clicks = clicks + 1
  WHERE code = _code
  RETURNING referrals.listing_id;
END;
$function$
